wrangler d1 execute localbleachersar-sports --remote --command="WITH sample(name) AS (VALUES ('BENTONVILLE HIGH SCHOOL'),('Bentonville West High School'),('Fayetteville High School'),('Har-Ber High School'),('Rogers High School'),('Rogers Heritage High School'),('Springdale High School'),('Farmington High School'),('Prairie Grove High School'),('Siloam Springs High School'),('CONWAY HIGH SCHOOL'),('Bryant High School'),('CABOT HIGH SCHOOL'),('North Little Rock High School'),('Little Rock Central High School'),('Little Rock Southwest High School'),('Pulaski Academy High School'),('Little Rock Christian Academy'),('GREENBRIER HIGH SCHOOL'),('VILONIA HIGH SCHOOL'),('Jonesboro High School'),('BROOKLAND HIGH SCHOOL'),('Batesville High School'),('Nettleton High School'),('Valley View High School'),('Paragould High School'),('Cave City High School'),('Pocahontas High School'),('Greene County Tech High School'),('Rivercrest High School'),('MOUNTAIN HOME HIGH SCHOOL'),('HARRISON HIGH SCHOOL'),('COTTER HIGH SCHOOL'),('VALLEY SPRINGS HIGH SCHOOL'),('BERGMAN HIGH SCHOOL'),('FLIPPIN HIGH SCHOOL'),('Huntsville High School'),('BERRYVILLE HIGH SCHOOL'),('Greenwood High School'),('VAN BUREN HIGH SCHOOL'),('Russellville High School'),('Paris High School'),('CHARLESTON HIGH SCHOOL'),('HACKETT HIGH SCHOOL'),('Lavaca High School'),('Alma High School'),('Mena High School'),('Magnolia High School'),('CAMDEN FAIRVIEW HIGH SCHOOL'),('Genoa Central High School'),('NASHVILLE HIGH SCHOOL'),('Arkadelphia High School')), teams AS (
SELECT s.name AS requested_name,t.team_id,t.school_id,t.school_name
FROM sample s
LEFT JOIN ONE_TRUTH_TB t ON t.row_type='TEAM' AND t.sport='volleyball' AND t.gender='girls' AND t.season='2026' AND lower(t.school_name)=lower(s.name)
)
SELECT requested_name,team_id,school_id,school_name,
COUNT(g.truth_id) AS games,
SUM(CASE WHEN g.status='FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finals,
SUM(CASE WHEN g.status<>'FINAL' AND datetime(g.scheduled_at)>datetime('2026-10-01T23:20:00Z') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future,
SUM(CASE WHEN g.status='FINAL' AND (g.team_score IS NULL OR g.opponent_score IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finals_missing_score
FROM teams
LEFT JOIN ONE_TRUTH_TB g ON g.row_type='GAME' AND g.team_id=teams.team_id
GROUP BY requested_name,team_id,school_id,school_name
ORDER BY requested_name;" --json
